caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a mezzaluna or a curved chopping knife, oriented horizontally on a plain, off-white background. The handle is cylindrical and appears to be made of wood, colored in light to medium brown tones with visible wood grain texture and some darker markings. The handle is attached to the blade via two curved, metallic arms that are a dark gray color, showing some shading to indicate wear or age. The large, curved blade is metallic, colored in shades of gray and brown, with visible patches of rust or discoloration to suggest use and aging. Beneath the object, the artist's signature, “George Roehl 1938,” is handwritten in pencil. There are no additional objects or elements in the composition; the focus is solely on the mezzaluna.
title: Chopper
